.newsletter-form input:focus{border-color:var(--teal)}
.newsletter-form input::placeholder{color:var(--gray-400)}
.btn-join{background:var(--coral);color:var(--white);padding:12px 28px;border-radius:var(--radius);font-size:15px;font-weight:600;transition:all .2s;white-space:nowrap}
.btn-join:hover{background:var(--coral-dark);transform:translateY(-1px);box-shadow:var(--shadow-md)}
.newsletter-privacy{font-size:12px;color:var(--gray-500);margin-top:8px;text-align:right}

/* === HEALTH TOPICS === */
.section{max-width:1320px;margin:0 auto;padding:56px 24px}
.section-header{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;margin-bottom:32px}
.section-title{font-family:var(--font-display);font-size:28px;font-weight:700;color:var(--charcoal);letter-spacing:-.01em}
.section-link{font-size:14px;font-weight:600;color:var(--teal);display:flex;align-items:center;gap:4px;transition:gap .2s}
.section-link:hover{gap:8px}
.topics-carousel{position:relative}
.topics-track{display:flex;gap:24px;overflow-x:auto;scroll-behavior:smooth;scrollbar-width:none;-ms-overflow-style:none;padding:8px 0}
.topics-track::-webkit-scrollbar{display:none}
.topic-card{flex-shrink:0;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:12px;cursor:pointer;transition:transform .2s}
.topic-card:hover{transform:translateY(-4px)}
.topic-img{width:110px;height:110px;border-radius:50%;overflow:hidden;border:3px solid var(--teal-50);transition:border-color .2s;box-shadow:var(--shadow)}
.topic-card:hover .topic-img{border-color:var(--teal)}
.topic-img-inner{width:100%;height:100%;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:36px}
.topic-label{font-size:14px;font-weight:600;color:var(--charcoal);text-align:center;max-width:120px;line-height:1.3}
.carousel-btn{position:absolute;top:50%;transform:translateY(-50%);width:40px;height:40px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--white);border:1px solid var(--gray-200);box-shadow:var(--shadow-md);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;z-index:5;transition:all .2s}
.carousel-btn:hover{background:var(--teal);border-color:var(--teal);color:var(--white)}
.carousel-btn svg{width:18px;height:18px}
.carousel-btn-left{left:-12px}
.carousel-btn-right{right:-12px}

/* === TOOLS === */
.tools-section{background:var(--white);border-top:1px solid var(--gray-200);border-bottom:1px solid var(--gray-200)}
.tools-inner{max-width:1320px;margin:0 auto;padding:56px 24px}
.tools-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:40px}
.nutrition-hub{background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--teal-50),#E0F2F4);border-radius:var(--radius-xl);padding:36px 32px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:20px}
.nutrition-hub h3{font-family:var(--font-display);font-size:24px;font-weight:700;color:var(--charcoal)}
.nutrition-hub p{font-size:15px;color:var(--gray-600);line-height:1.55}
.btn-hub{background:var(--teal);color:var(--white);padding:10px 24px;border-radius:var(--radius);font-size:14px;font-weight:600;width:fit-content;transition:all .2s}
.btn-hub:hover{background:var(--teal-dark);transform:translateY(-1px);box-shadow:var(--shadow-md)}
.nutrition-tools{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:12px}
.nutrition-tool{display:flex;align-items:flex-start;gap:12px;padding:12px;background:var(--white);border-radius:var(--radius);border:1px solid rgba(2,131,141,.1);transition:all .2s;cursor:pointer}
.nutrition-tool:hover{border-color:var(--teal);box-shadow:var(--shadow)}
.tool-icon{width:36px;height:36px;border-radius:var(--radius-sm);background:var(--teal);color:var(--white);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;flex-shrink:0}
.tool-icon svg{width:18px;height:18px}
.tool-text h4{font-size:14px;font-weight:600;color:var(--charcoal);margin-bottom:2px}
.tool-text p{font-size:13px;color:var(--gray-500);line-height:1.4}
.care-tools{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:12px}
.care-tool{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:16px;padding:16px 20px;background:var(--gray-50);border-radius:var(--radius);border:1px solid var(--gray-200);transition:all .2s;cursor:pointer}
.care-tool:hover{border-color:var(--teal);background:var(--teal-50);box-shadow:var(--shadow)}
.care-tool-icon{width:44px;height:44px;border-radius:var(--radius);background:var(--white);border:1px solid var(--gray-200);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;flex-shrink:0;color:var(--teal)}
.care-tool-icon svg{width:20px;height:20px}
.care-tool-content{flex:1}
.care-tool-content h4{font-size:15px;font-weight:600;color:var(--charcoal);margin-bottom:2px}
.care-tool-content p{font-size:13px;color:var(--gray-500);line-height:1.4}
.care-tool-arrow{color:var(--gray-400);transition:color .2s,transform .2s}
.care-tool:hover .care-tool-arrow{color:var(--teal);transform:translateX(3px)}

/* === RECOMMENDED READS === */
.reads-tabs{display:flex;gap:4px;border-bottom:2px solid var(--gray-200);padding-bottom:0;margin-bottom:28px;overflow-x:auto;scrollbar-width:none}
.reads-tabs::-webkit-scrollbar{display:none}
.reads-tab{padding:10px 20px;font-size:14px;font-weight:500;color:var(--gray-500);border-bottom:2px solid transparent;margin-bottom:-2px;transition:all .2s;white-space:nowrap;cursor:pointer;border-radius:var(--radius-sm) var(--radius-sm) 0 0}
.reads-tab:hover{color:var(--teal);background:var(--teal-50)}
.reads-tab.active{color:var(--teal);border-bottom-color:var(--teal);font-weight:600;background:var(--teal-50)}
.reads-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:24px}
.read-card{background:var(--white);border:1px solid var(--gray-200);border-radius:var(--radius-lg);overflow:hidden;transition:all .2s;cursor:pointer}
.read-card:hover{box-shadow:var(--shadow-lg);transform:translateY(-3px);border-color:var(--teal-100)}
.read-card-img{height:180px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:48px;position:relative}
.read-card-img .cat-badge{position:absolute;top:12px;left:12px;font-size:11px;font-weight:700;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.04em;padding:4px 12px;border-radius:100px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.9);backdrop-filter:blur(4px);color:var(--teal)}
.read-card-body{padding:20px}
.read-card-body h3{font-size:17px;font-weight:600;line-height:1.35;color:var(--charcoal);margin-bottom:8px;transition:color .2s}
.read-card:hover .read-card-body h3{color:var(--teal)}
.read-card-body p{font-size:13px;color:var(--gray-500);line-height:1.5}
.read-card-author{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;padding:0 20px 16px;font-size:12px;color:var(--gray-400)}

/* === TRUST === */
.trust-section{background:linear-gradient(180deg,var(--white) 0%,var(--teal-50) 100%)}
.trust-inner{max-width:1320px;margin:0 auto;padding:64px 24px;text-align:center}
.trust-title{font-family:var(--font-display);font-size:32px;font-weight:700;color:var(--charcoal);margin-bottom:40px;line-height:1.25}
.trust-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:32px}
.trust-card{background:var(--white);border-radius:var(--radius-lg);padding:32px 24px;border:1px solid var(--gray-200);transition:all .3s}
.trust-card:hover{box-shadow:var(--shadow-lg);transform:translateY(-3px);border-color:var(--teal-100)}
.trust-icon{width:56px;height:56px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--teal-50);color:var(--teal);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;margin:0 auto 16px;font-size:24px}
.trust-card h3{font-size:17px;font-weight:700;color:var(--charcoal);margin-bottom:8px}
.trust-card p{font-size:14px;color:var(--gray-600);line-height:1.55}

/* === FEATURED PROGRAMS === */
.programs-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:20px}
.program-card{background:var(--white);border:1px solid var(--gray-200);border-radius:var(--radius-lg);overflow:hidden;transition:all .2s;cursor:pointer}
.program-card:hover{box-shadow:var(--shadow-lg);transform:translateY(-3px);border-color:var(--teal-100)}
.program-card-img{height:160px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:40px}
.program-card-body{padding:16px 20px}
.program-card-body h3{font-size:15px;font-weight:600;color:var(--charcoal);line-height:1.35}

/* === VIDEOS === */
.videos-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:20px}
.video-card{background:var(--white);border:1px solid var(--gray-200);border-radius:var(--radius-lg);overflow:hidden;transition:all .2s;cursor:pointer}
.video-card:hover{box-shadow:var(--shadow-lg);transform:translateY(-3px)}
.video-card-img{height:160px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;position:relative;font-size:40px}
.video-play{position:absolute;width:48px;height:48px;border-radius:50%;background:rgba(255,255,255,.9);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;box-shadow:var(--shadow-md);transition:transform .2s}
.video-card:hover .video-play{transform:scale(1.1)}
.video-play svg{width:20px;height:20px;color:var(--teal);margin-left:2px}
.video-card-body{padding:16px 20px}
.video-card-body h3{font-size:14px;font-weight:600;color:var(--charcoal);line-height:1.4}

/* === FOOTER === */
.site-footer{background:var(--charcoal);color:var(--gray-300)}
.footer-top{max-width:1320px;margin:0 auto;padding:48px 24px 36px;display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:48px;align-items:start;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.1)}
.footer-newsletter h3{font-family:var(--font-display);font-size:22px;font-weight:600;color:var(--white);margin-bottom:8px;line-height:1.3}
.footer-newsletter p{font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;max-width:420px;margin-bottom:16px}
.footer-form{display:flex;gap:8px}
.footer-form input{padding:10px 16px;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.2);border-radius:var(--radius);font-size:14px;width:280px;outline:none;background:rgba(255,255,255,.08);color:var(--white);transition:border-color .2s}
.footer-form input::placeholder{color:var(--gray-500)}
.footer-form input:focus{border-color:var(--teal-light)}
.btn-footer-signup{background:var(--teal);color:var(--white);padding:10px 24px;border-radius:var(--radius);font-size:14px;font-weight:600;transition:all .2s;white-space:nowrap}
.btn-footer-signup:hover{background:var(--teal-light)}
.footer-links-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:24px}
.footer-links-grid a{font-size:13px;color:var(--gray-400);transition:color .2s;line-height:1.8;display:block}
.footer-links-grid a:hover{color:var(--white)}
.footer-bottom{max-width:1320px;margin:0 auto;padding:24px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:16px}
.footer-legal{font-size:12px;color:var(--gray-500);line-height:1.6;max-width:600px}
.footer-social{display:flex;gap:16px}
.footer-social a{color:var(--gray-400);transition:color .2s;font-size:13px;font-weight:500}
.footer-social a:hover{color:var(--white)}

/* === RESPONSIVE === */
@media(max-width:1024px){
  .hero-section{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:28px}
  .hero-title{font-size:30px}
  .newsletter-inner{flex-direction:column;text-align:center}
  .newsletter-text p{margin:0 auto}
  .newsletter-form{flex-direction:column;align-items:center;width:100%}
  .newsletter-form input{width:100%;max-width:400px}
  .tools-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}
  .trust-grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr)}
  .programs-grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr)}
  .videos-grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr)}
  .reads-grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr)}
  .footer-top{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:32px}
  .footer-links-grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr)}
  .mega-menu{min-width:unset;left:0;transform:none;width:100vw;margin-left:-24px}
}
@media(max-width:768px){
  .nav-list{display:none}
  .mobile-menu-btn{display:flex}
  .hero-main{padding:32px 24px;min-height:320px}
  .hero-title{font-size:26px}
  .hero-subtitle{font-size:15px}
  .trending-sidebar{margin-top:0}
  .reads-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}
  .trust-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}
  .programs-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}
  .videos-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}
  .section-title{font-size:22px}
  .newsletter-text h2{font-size:24px}
  .trust-title{font-size:24px}
  .footer-form{flex-direction:column}
  .footer-form input{width:100%}
  .footer-bottom{flex-direction:column;text-align:center}
  .footer-links-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}
}
.mobile-menu-btn{display:none;width:40px;height:40px;align-items:center;justify-content:center;border-radius:var(--radius-sm);border:1px solid var(--gray-200)}
@media(max-width:768px){.mobile-menu-btn{display:flex}}

The WellSource homepage is complete at `/app/output/index.html`. Here's what's included:

**Sections built:**
1. **Credibility stats ticker** — continuously scrolling bar with 145 medical reviewers, 21 years experience, 55M monthly readers, with gradient fade edges and pause-on-hover
2. **Header with mega-menu navigation** — 5 nav items (Health Conditions, Wellness, Tools, Featured, Connect) each with structured dropdown panels with categorized sub-links
3. **Hero** — teal gradient with 30-day fitness challenge badge, article title, and subtitle
4. **Trending articles sidebar** — numbered list with category labels
5. **Newsletter CTA** — coral "Join Now" button with email input and privacy note
6. **Health Topics carousel** — circular image cards with left/right arrow navigation and smooth scroll
7. **Health Tools** — two-column layout with Nutrition Hub (3 tools) and Drug & Care tools (4 items)
8. **Recommended Reads** — 6 category tabs (Top Reads, Fitness, Mental Well-Being, Product Reviews, Recipes, Skin Care) that dynamically swap the article grid
9. **Trust Pillars** — 4-card grid explaining editorial credibility
10. **Featured Programs** — 4 editorial program cards
11. **Latest Videos** — 4 video cards with play buttons
12. **Footer** — newsletter signup, link grid, legal text, social links

**Design choices:**
- **Typography**: Playfair Display (headlines) + DM Sans (body) — editorial magazine feel with high readability
- **Colors**: Teal (#02838D) primary, coral (#E8734A) accent, warm whites, charcoal text
- **Interactions**: All tabs, carousel, mega-menus, and newsletter forms are fully functional
- **Responsive**: Full breakpoints at 1024px and 768px
